description.value: Village Eatery — operating under the fuller name Village Eatery & Pizza House on its own website — is a Mediterranean-influenced cafe and restaurant situated in the heart of Qualicum Beach Village. The menu ranges from Greek classics like spanakopita, chicken gyro, and prawns saganaki to pizzas, fresh baking, and morning coffees, with outdoor seating available. Weekly community events including charity Music Bingo and Tuesday Trivia make it a lively local gathering point.
